# Control card (`control-card`)

Frame for one controllable thing: icon badge, title, state, a trailing control, media and body slots.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createControlCard` (types in `dist/web/home/controlCard.d.ts`): `.mh-control-card`: the frame for one controllable thing. `__media` on top, then `__header` with `__main` (`__badge` icon, `__text` with `__title` and `__state`) and the trailing `__control`, then `__body`. With `onOpen`, `__main` is a `<button>` and the trailing control stays its sibling, so no interactive element sits inside another. The control and body slots are `<fieldset>`s, so `unavailable` disables every native control in them. Modifiers `--warm | --heat | --cool`, `--pressable`; states `.is-active`, `.is-loading`, `.is-unavailable`.

```ts
export function createControlCard(options: ControlCardOptions): ControlCardHandle;

export interface ControlCardOptions {
  /** The thing's name; wraps, never cut short. Also the card's accessible name. */
  title: string;
  /** Leading icon: a short name or a raw MDI path. */
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** The state line ("On · 80%", "21.5 °C"), shown as given. */
  state?: string;
  /** The badge takes the lit look. */
  active?: boolean;
  /** Colour of the lit look (default `accent`). `warm`, `heat` and `cool` use the home colours when present. */
  tone?: ControlCardTone;
  /** Trailing control beside the title (a switch, a button). */
  control?: HTMLElement | null;
  /** On top, edge to edge (an image). */
  media?: HTMLElement | null;
  /** Below the header (sliders, rows). */
  body?: HTMLElement | null;
  /** Waiting for the thing: dimmed, with a spinner in place of the control. */
  loading?: boolean;
  /** Spoken while loading (default "Updating"). */
  loadingLabel?: string;
  /** The thing can't be reached: muted, and the controls in the control and body slots are disabled. */
  unavailable?: boolean;
  /** Makes the header (badge, title, state) a button that opens more controls. */
  onOpen?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ControlCardHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Applies changed options; omitted ones keep their value (`null` clears a slot). */
  update(changes: Partial<ControlCardOptions>): void;
}
```

`createSwitch` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/switch.d.ts`): `.mh-switch` (`--row` for the settings toggle row): a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`, so Space toggles it and screen readers announce on/off. The track takes the control radius, so square corners give a square switch.

```ts
export function createSwitch(options: SwitchOptions): SwitchHandle;

export interface SwitchOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  /** A second line under the label (announced as the description). */
  description?: string;
  checked?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** The settings toggle row: label (and icon) at the start, the switch at the end, full width. */
  row?: boolean;
  /** A leading icon in the row. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  name?: string;
  onChange?: (checked: boolean, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface SwitchHandle {
  el: HTMLLabelElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  isChecked(): boolean;
  setChecked(checked: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createControlCard, createSwitch } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let on = true;
const stateText = () => (on ? 'On · 70%' : 'Off');

const power = createSwitch({
  ariaLabel: 'Desk lamp power',
  checked: on,
  onChange: (checked) => {
    on = checked;
    card.update({ active: on, state: stateText() });
  },
});

const card = createControlCard({
  title: 'Desk lamp',
  icon: 'lightbulb',
  tone: 'warm',
  active: on,
  state: stateText(),
  control: power.el,
});

document.body.append(card.el);
```

`ControlCard` (types in `dist/react/home-controls.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createControlCard`.

```ts
export function ControlCard({ title, icon, state, active, tone, control, media, children, loading, loadingLabel = 'Updating', unavailable, onOpen, className }: ControlCardProps);

export interface ControlCardProps {
  /** The thing's name; wraps, never cut short. Also the card's accessible name. */
  title: string;
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** The state line, shown as given. */
  state?: string;
  active?: boolean;
  tone?: ControlCardTone;
  /** Trailing control beside the title. */
  control?: ReactNode;
  /** On top, edge to edge. */
  media?: ReactNode;
  /** The body below the header. */
  children?: ReactNode;
  loading?: boolean;
  loadingLabel?: string;
  /** Muted, and every native control in the control and body slots disabled. */
  unavailable?: boolean;
  /** Makes the header a button that opens more controls. */
  onOpen?: (event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

`Switch` (types in `dist/react/choice-inputs.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createSwitch`: `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`.

```ts
export function Switch({ label, description, row, icon, className, ...rest }: SwitchProps);

export interface SwitchProps extends NativeCheckbox {
  label?: ReactNode;
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** The settings toggle row: label at the start, switch at the end. */
  row?: boolean;

}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ControlCard, Switch } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ControlCardExample() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(true);
  return (
    <ControlCard
      title="Desk lamp"
      icon="lightbulb"
      tone="warm"
      active={on}
      state={on ? 'On · 70%' : 'Off'}
      control={
        <Switch aria-label="Desk lamp power" checked={on} onChange={(event) => setOn(event.target.checked)} />
      }
    />
  );
}
```
